snippet.title: ASA Therizinosaurus TLC Trailer
snippet.description:
Therizinosaurus is now stepping up for its turn in the TLC spotlight!

Thanks to your Extra Life vote, one of ARK's most iconic creatures is getting a fresh coat of feathers, all while staying true to the role Survivors have relied on for years. Rather than redefining the creature, this TLC focuses on improving combat responsiveness, controls, traversal, visual progression and expanding the creature’s personality. 

The Therizino has always had a reputation for turning an innocent stroll through the woods into a frantic sprint for your life, and that isn't changing anytime soon. Survivors will find that wild ones are a little more patient than they used to be. They now make their intentions crystal clear, fixing you with an unblinking stare, spreading those infamous claws, and giving you one last chance to reconsider your life choices. Whether you heed that warning is entirely up to you.

Thank you again to everyone who supported Extra Life and helped bring this TLC to life. Next stop, Giganotosaurus!

LYRICS

My ship is loaded with darkness 
The years of our world in demise 
My walls are coated with sorrow 
I can hardly remember the light 
But the oceans of hope they keep calling 
As I cut through the waves in my sky 
And my broadside still fires on treason 
My weatherworn faith never lies, no 
 
I’ll sail my dreams away to blue horizons 
Far from the waters that I see 
Anchoring my vision in a brand-new dawning 
To seal the pain that never leaves 
The Stormwatcher bleeds 

Let the crosswinds carry me 
 
Confined to my quarters of shadow 
Those demons I can’t let you see 
Inside this logbook of travels 
Captains of lost legacy, yeah 
 
The Watcher navigates when winds are rising 
His compass pointing through the rain 
Standing steady at the helm in his eyes a warning 
A dark crescendo he knows well 
The Stormwatcher’s hell 
 
Now my black ship lays scattered and broken 
On a seabed of ghosts that won’t die 
I’ll be firing my cannons tomorrow 
You’ll sing the songs that I cry 
 
The future never sleeps, the time is running 
Sailing on wings of destiny 
Somewhere on the outline waits the cloudless morning 
A place your heart it longs to be 
Stormwatcher screams 
 
Pushing through the blackest night, find your spirit, bring the light 
The Stormwatcher’s hell
